_comment: Property market, investors, tax, insurance and the owner's own life.

theft.name: Theft Cover
theft.description: Pays back 80% of the value of anything a shoplifter gets away with.

breakdown.name: Breakdown Cover
breakdown.description: Call-out repairs on broken machines cost you nothing.

liability.name: Liability Cover
liability.description: Pays 75% of fines from inspections and other mishaps.

disaster.name: Fire and Flood Cover
disaster.description: Pays 90% of the damage when a fire, flood or power cut hits one of your businesses.

studio.name: Rented Room
studio.description: A bed and a kettle. You recover slowly.

apartment.name: Apartment
apartment.description: Your own front door and a proper night's sleep.

house.name: Town House
house.description: Room to breathe. You bounce back quickly.

penthouse.name: Penthouse
penthouse.description: The view over the city you are buying up. You are rarely tired.

none.name: On Foot
none.description: Getting between your shops takes it out of you.

used.name: Used Hatchback
used.description: Starts most mornings. Halves the effort of getting around.

sedan.name: Saloon
sedan.description: Comfortable and quick. You can call in on most of your shops in a day.

sports.name: Sports Car
sports.description: Everywhere is five minutes away, and everyone sees you arrive.
